notes: The original 1024 workflow completed 992 rows; timed-out shards 30 and 57 were rerun independently and contributed the missing 32 rows.
A dedicated finalization workflow consolidated all 1024 rows into auditable JSONL and SQLite and re-enforced the complete safety, provenance and reproducibility contract.
All 53 accepted rows have at least two independent OCR engine families and four corroborated core fields, with calories, protein, carbohydrate and fat present.
No REVIEW row is promoted to usable nutrition; there are no ERROR or NO_VISUAL_REGION outcomes in the final sample.
The recovered 1024-product wave is a strict deterministic superset of the validated 512-product wave.
All 512 prior statuses reproduced exactly and every prior DECLARED nutrition value remained identical.
The 5.18% acceptance rate remains deliberately conservative and supports a further bounded 2048-product scale-up before executing the full 2630-product eligible universe.
